senses.gloss: 1. ग (3rd consonant of the alphabet), the soft guttural having the sound g in give
ग m. N. of Gaṇeśa, L.
2. ग mf(आ)n. (√ गम्) only ifc. going, moving (e.g. यान-, going in a carriage, Mn. iv, 120; Yājñ. iii, 291; शीघ्र-, going quickly, R. iii, 31, 3; cf. अन्तरिक्ष- &c.)
staying, being, abiding in VarBṛ.; Ragh. iii, 13; Kathās. &c. (e.g. पञ्चम-, abiding in or keeping the fifth place, Śrut.)
relating to or standing in connection with, R. vi, 70, 59; BhP. &c. (cf. अ-, अग्र-, अ-जिह्म-, अत्यन्त-, &c.; अग्रे-ग॑, &c.)
3. ग mf(ई, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 8)n. (√ गै) only ifc. singing (cf. छन्दो-, पुराण-, साम-)
ग m. a Gandharva or celestial musician, L.
4. ग (used in works on prosody as an abbreviation of the word गुरु to denote) a long syllable, W.
(in music used as an abbreviation of the word गान्धार to denote) the third note.
गा [cf. βίβημι, ἔβην; Old Germ. gām, gās, &c.; Goth. ga-tvo; Eng. to go.]
2. गा mfn. Ved. ifc. ‘going’ (cf. अ-गा; अग्रे-, तमो-, पुरो-, समन- and स्वस्ति-गा॑), Pāṇ. iii, 2, 67.
3. गा mfn. (√ गै) ifc. ‘singing’, see साम-गा
